detail.title: Intex LTC 925 | Laser Toner Cartridge (up to 2000-page yield)
detail.overview: The Intex LTC 925 toner cartridge ensures maximum print efficiency and reliability. Built with a high-quality drum, it guarantees excellent page yield and top-tier performance for both text and image documents. Compatible with popular Canon and HP printer models, it’s ideal for personal, home-office, and business use. Get consistently bold prints with superior clarity and smudge-free results, every time.
